entities.name: NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: UE substate where no cell is available for service.

entities.name: NORMAL-SERVICE
entities.description: UE substate entered when a cell is found and normal service can be resumed.

entities.name: Cell Selection
entities.description: UE procedure to search for and select an available cell according to 3GPP TS 36.304.

entities.name: S101 mode to S1 mode handover
entities.description: Handover procedure from S101 mode to S1 mode.

entities.name: Cell found condition
entities.description: Condition where UE successfully finds a cell during cell selection.

entities.name: PLMN not in forbidden lists
entities.description: Condition where the PLMN identity of the target cell is not in any forbidden PLMN list.

relations.description: UE in NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state performs cell selection procedure.
Successful cell selection establishes cell found condition.
Cell found condition leads to transition to NORMAL-SERVICE state.
S101 to S1 handover requires PLMN not in forbidden lists condition.
PLMN not forbidden condition establishes transition to NORMAL-SERVICE state.
